title: Succinate fermentation: bounded source-level scientific assessment

reviewer.independence_basis: The same agent implemented the evidence workflow and assessed this source; this is not independent reviewer agreement.

assessments.rationale: The cited primary description explicitly reports succinate fermentation by the isolate named Succiniclasticum ruminis (type strain SE10/DSM 9236). This supports the row's general fermentation-capability interpretation for the described organism. It does not support fermentation of unspecified carbohydrates, universal behavior across strains, or growth without the reported medium supplements.

dimensions.taxon: The primary abstract names Succiniclasticum ruminis and identifies type strain SE10/DSM 9236; the pinned subject label agrees. The external LPSN identifier mapping itself was not independently re-curated.
dimensions.predicate: biolink:capable_of is consistent with an observed fermentation capability, without asserting a causal pathway or reaction stoichiometry.
dimensions.object: The original value and pinned METPO label are Fermentation; the source explicitly uses fermented for succinate conversion.
dimensions.context: Observed isolate; anaerobic rumen culture, succinate substrate, with rumen fluid and yeast extract required for good growth. Do not generalize to carbohydrate fermentation or all culture conditions.
dimensions.evidence_scope: Direct primary-source abstract supporting a bounded capability interpretation. No independent validation of the entire taxon or ontology identifier mapping; no native claim admission.

quotes.summary: The primary description explicitly reports fermentation of succinate.

quotes.quote: the type strain is strain SE10 (= DSM 9236).
quotes.summary: The observation is anchored to the described isolate, not all strains or environments.
